prompt: Mid-case: Delivery times rose from 3 to 5 days. You've found that warehouse processing takes 2 extra days since a new system launched in March, and that carrier transit time is unchanged. You haven't looked at staffing. Which is the best summary?

options.text: So far: almost all of the 2-day increase comes from warehouse processing, which slowed after the new system launched in March; carrier transit is unchanged. We haven't yet looked at warehouse staffing, so next I'd check whether staffing changed at the same time.
options.feedback: Right. It states what is known, with numbers, then what is still open and what comes next.

options.text: So far: the warehouse and the carriers both slowed, adding a day each. Next I'd look at staffing.
options.feedback: This claims findings the analysis hasn't shown. Summarize only what you've established.

The main finding so far is that almost all of the 2-day increase comes from warehouse processing, which slowed after the new system launched in March; carrier transit is unchanged.
options.feedback: The answer comes last. Lead with the recommendation, then support it.

options.text: So far: almost all of the 2-day increase comes from warehouse processing, which slowed after the new system launched in March; carrier transit is unchanged. The carrier recently rebranded. Next I'd check whether staffing changed at the same time.
